remarks: Live the SoNo lifestyle with this spacious 1-bedroom directly on the Washington Street strip! - This unit features an updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances and tons of cabinet space - Large windows surround the open concept living/dining room, creating a bright, sunsoaked ambience - Bedroom features generous closet space with built-in shelving - Large bathroom with built-in cabinetry and updated vanity - Washer/dryer in unit! - Hardwood floors throughout - Walk right outside your downstairs door to beautiful water views, the Maritime Aquarium, the SoNo Collection, the movie theater, and SoNo's many award-winning bars and restaurants! - No pets, 1 year lease minimum
